messages:
Asha (partnerships): Quick sync — IntegratorX ran a full demo + 2-hr workshop yesterday. Sales is asking to 'claim' follow-ups. We need a short, operational rule for post-demo ownership (SI vs Redwood AE) that we can paste into playbooks and CRM notes.
Tom (sales): We need something binary and fast. Who hosted + who did discovery should be main signals. If SI did discovery and delivered value, they should keep ownership until POV/POC completes.
Priya (si-ops): Confirming: SI hosted, did discovery, captured requirements, and introduced the champion. They also ran the POC lab environment. From SI side we expect to keep primary ownership unless AE was explicitly leading next steps.
Javier (solutions): Agree. Propose we make a definitive mapping with a fallback window (72h) for handoffs. Also need to record evidence in the CRM (POC notes, workshop slides, champion intro).
Asha (partnerships): Draft rule idea below — please review. If we land on this, I'll ask marketing to add to the partner playbook and vendors onboarding doc.
Tom (sales): Pasteable rule pls.
Javier (solutions): Here — simple and scriptable: 

```
# Lead ownership rules (Integrator co-sell)
# Inputs: demo_host, poc_completed, redwood_ae_present, sow_signed, redwood_ae_led_followup
IF demo_host == "SI" AND (poc_completed == true OR sow_signed == true):
  owner = "SI"
ELIF redwood_ae_present == true AND redwood_ae_led_followup == true:
  owner = "Redwood AE"
ELIF demo_host == "Redwood" AND redwood_ae_led == true:
  owner = "Redwood AE"
ELSE:
  owner = "Shared"  # requires explicit handoff in 72h with evidence uploaded
```

Priya (si-ops): Love it. Two additions: 1) when owner=="SI" we auto-tag account_source=SI-Partner in CRM, 2) require a short POC sign-off doc (checkbox + champion email) to be uploaded.
Asha (partnerships): Good — add the advocate-claiming flow too. Whoever introduced the champion gets an "SI-Advocate" tag and a 3-point ask: intro, POC support, and exec intro by milestone. This helps credit and routing.
Tom (sales): What about disputes? If AE disagrees with SI claim we need an escalation channel.
Javier (solutions): Escalation flow: post the thread in #partnerships with CRM links + evidence (workshop slides, champion intro). Partnerships PM triages and assigns ownership within 48h. If contested after PM decision, escalate to Head of Partnerships + Sales Ops.
Asha (partnerships): Also need a CRM field template for notes so automation can pick it up. Javier can you post the template?
Javier (solutions): Will do. Template preview: 

```
CRM field: integrator_claim (enum: SI, Redwood AE, Shared)
CRM field: integrator_evidence_url (string)
CRM field: si_advocate (string)
CRM field: demo_date (date)
CRM note: "POC: yes/no; SOW: yes/no; ChampionEmail: x@org"
```

Marketplace Bot: auto-tagging rules updated. Commands: `/marketplace tag-add <account> SI-Advocate` will add the tag and set followup_reminder=7d.
Tom (sales): Two asks to close: 1) tie to commission splits (who owns the opp at close), 2) make the 72h handoff window visible in SFDC.
Asha (partnerships): For commission splits we'll loop in sales-ops + finance — I'll start the thread with them. For visibility: Marketplace Bot will set a 72h handoff_deadline field when owner=="Shared".
Priya (si-ops): Action items: 
- Priya: add POC sign-off doc template and link to partner onboarding (due EOD Fri).
- Javier: post CRM field template and automation example (due Wed).
- Tom: update sales playbook snippet and notify AEs in next Monday standup (due Mon).
- Asha: circulate final rule and escalation flow to partner PMs + legal for acknowledgement (due Thu).

Everyone: please react with :+1: if you agree to the rule above and the action owners.

Tom (sales): +1
Priya (si-ops): +1
Javier (solutions): +1
Asha (partnerships): thanks — I’ll consolidate and post a short playbook entry once items are in.
Marketplace Bot: Tagging enabled for IntegratorX account as `SI-Advocate` and set followup_reminder=7d — automation note ID mq-7782.
Tom (sales): 👍 thanks, feel better having a crisp rule.
